authentication.note: Public tools do not require authentication. draft_chase_email requires either a signed-in session or a Bearer API key created from the Docstoc Connector page.

tools.name: get_chase_tip
tools.description: Get a short chase-tone tip for how late an invoice is.

tools.name: recommend_template
tools.description: Recommend a Docstoc payment reminder template for the given days-overdue stage.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List Docstoc free invoice follow-up templates with URLs.

tools.name: draft_chase_email
tools.description: Draft a payment follow-up email for an overdue invoice. Returns subject and body only.
